hypothesis: getCachedToken() blindly trusts localStorage without verifying JWT expiration (exp) or format integrity. An expired or corrupted token halts silent exchange in ensureValidSession, locking the client in a permanent 401 loop.

api.ts fetch interceptor only synchronously queries getCachedToken(). If an API request is fired during cold boot before ensureValidSession completes, the request is dispatched without Authorization header, failing with 401.

update_day_data (PATCH /{trip_id}/day-data) relies on Header(None, alias='X-User-ID') instead of Depends(get_verified_user). An attacker can spoof another collaborator's user ID without any cryptographic signature to overwrite trip day metadata.

generate_ledger_share_code (PATCH /{trip_id}/ledger-share) directly extracts x_user_id: str = Header(None, alias='X-User-ID') without JWT validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to generate or reset ledger sharing codes.
seed_sample_trip (POST /trips/seed-sample) accepts unauthenticated X-User-ID header without JWT validation, allowing attackers to trigger sample seeding for arbitrary UUIDs.
